notes.title: Impact Trial: Hyperchaos Has Arrived!!
notes.notes:
[p][b]Hello everyone![/b][/p][p]I'm Manuel Bacallado, creator of [i]Impact Trial: Hyperchaos[/i].[/p][p]Just over a year ago, I released [i]Impact Trial: First Encounter[/i] — the “younger sibling” of [i]Hyperchaos[/i] — but I made the mistake of not sharing any updates during development, thinking no one would read them. This time, I want to do things differently.[/p][p]This is the first official post about [b][i]Impact Trial: Hyperchaos[/i][/b], a [b]2D Bullet Hell[/b] I've been working on over the past few months. It's designed to be [b]faster[/b], more [b]competitive[/b], and fully focused on [b]Steam leaderboards[/b] — and yes, there will be a demo before launch![/p][p]The game is still in active development and is already playable in its alpha version. I’m working hard to polish the core mechanics and introduce dynamic systems that reward both skill and adaptability.[/p][p]🎯 If you enjoy bullet hell challenges and love competitive arcade experiences, I genuinely believe you’ll have a blast with [i]Hyperchaos[/i].[/p][p]Your feedback means a lot — feel free to leave a comment, and don’t forget to add the game to your wishlist if it caught your eye. It really helps![/p][p]See you in the Hyperchaos,
 — Manuel Bacallado[/p]
